landing.seoDescription: Create wedding invitations from beautiful templates or upload your own design. Send via link, email, or print. Real-time RSVP tracking.
landing.heroTitle: Made for you. Designed for them.
landing.heroSubtitle: Pick a template or upload your own design. Share it anywhere and track RSVPs in real time.
landing.featureAiDescription: Choose from AI-recommended templates that match your style — or upload an invitation you've already designed.
landing.featureSendDescription: Share your invitation via link, email, or printable PDF. Reach every guest the way that works best.
landing.featureRsvpDescription: Know who's coming with real-time RSVP tracking. No more guessing or follow-up calls.
landing.step1Description: Choose a template that fits your style, or upload your own invitation design.

landing.step3Description: Send your invitation by link, email, or download a PDF.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready to create your perfect invitation?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Become one of the couples who chose Eloria for their special day.
